blocks.text: Jo poday carbon fix karne ke liye Calvin cycle istemal karte hain unhein C-3 plants kehte hain. In podon mein photorespiration hone se fix kiye hue carbon ka 25% se 50% zaya ho jata hai, aur paidawar (yield) kam ho jati hai. Photorespiration ki raftar temperature par bhi munhasir hai: zyada temperature par rubisco ka oxygen jorne wala (oxidative) kaam us ke carbon fix karne wale kaam se zyada barh jata hai. Garam (tropical) ilaqon mein, khaas taur par jahan temperature aksar 28 °C se upar rehta hai, yeh masla shadeed hai aur fasalon ki paidawar par bura asar dalta hai.

Jab photosynthesis pehli baar shuru hui to hawa mein oxygen bohat kam thi, is liye photorespiration kam ya bilkul nahin hoti thi. Karoron saal baad hawa mein azaad O₂ jama ho gayi aur rubisco ke ek hi active site ke liye CO₂ aur O₂ mein muqabla shuru ho gaya. Isi se woh masla paida hua jo aaj photorespiration ki shakal mein hai.
